page.overview:
What is Dwarven catacombs?

The dwarven catacombs are located in the forest beyond the stream north of the town of Vergen. (Use the stairs to the right of the town gate.) Within are a number of corpses and some breakable walls, not to mention a number of wraiths haunting the halls. A wraith may also appear to defend any corpse that Geralt decides to disturb, making investigation treacherous.

Ultimately, Geralt finds the wraith of Ekhart Henessy there.
